title: Dogwood Vue | Scenic 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Dogwood Vue is a luxury, pet-friendly 30A home with Gulf views, a private pool, elevator, golf cart, bikes, and just 100 yards to the beach near Seaside.
description_expanded: Dogwood Vue Features - 100yds to Dogwood/Thyme Beach Access. - 1 Block to Seaside and 1min bike ride to shopping and dining district of Seaside - Stunning Gulf Views from top floor lounge - 1st floor Game Room with Pool/Ping Pong Table Combo - Private Pool and fenced in backyard. Pool heating available for an additional fee for all reservations October - April - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 45 pounds or less, and non-shedding. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - Access to a 6-Seater LSV (golf cart)- Must sign a waiver to gain access - Access to 6 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape for your arrival - Private elevator to all floors. Adult use only. Please ask for details regarding mobility considerations for anyone in your group. - 3rd Floor Living room w/ large Smart TV + an additional sitting area w/ fireplace - 3rd Floor Dining area w/ seating for 12 around live edge dining table - 3rd Floor Gourmet kitchen w high-end appliances including 2 dishwashers and a SubZero fridge, a waterfall kitchen island and breakfast bar seating for 5 - 3rd Floor Wet bar with stand-alone ice maker and wine fridge - 4th Floor Lounge with Smart TV and Gulf Views - 4th Floor Kitchenette with a full-size fridge, breakfast bar seating for 3, and dining table for 5 - 4th Floor open air lounge with a fire pit, cushioned seating set, lounge chairs, and a Gulf View - 1st floor Living Room with Smart TV - 1st Floor Kitchenette with ice maker, microwave, and drink fridge - Summer Kitchen on the covered poolside patio with a built in Beef Eater Gas Grill - Outdoor Shower - Smart TVs with streaming services and Wifi throughout the home (no cable) - Kingsdown Pillowtop Mattresses throughout the home - very luxurious -1st and 2nd floor laundry rooms - Driveway parking for 4 vehicles - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Searching for a top-of-the-line designer vacation home for your crew and pup? Look no further! No expense was spared to ensure a luxurious experience at Dogwood Vue. Thoughtfully designed for 20 guests and your dog to enjoy, every inch of this home is immaculate. Pet Friendly? Check! Gulf Views? Check! Private pool? Check! LSV (golf cart) and bikes? Check! Designer interiors? Check! Outdoor fire pit? Check! Professional kitchen? Check! Summer kitchen and 2 kitchenettes! Smart TVs? Check! 100 yds to the beach? Check! Area Construction - Due to the outstanding beaches and amazing communities along 30A, our area is getting more popular each year. There is a high possibility of nearby construction, home remodels, community changes and county projects on the roads and bridges along 30A year-round and throughout every single community. Please be aware that refunds will not be issued due to noise disturbance or unsightly views due to nearby projects. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
